attrs.Help_string:
Overview:
  Lips for local face rigs (Jaw block + Lips block, BodyLips local geo), with the MouthGames v003 lip features.
  Like Lips v001 / v002 the lips are their own system: moving the jaw never moves them (the BodyJaw layer does the jaw part), and the Jaw and Lips blocks build in any order. The whole mouth follows SetParent.
  GameMode off (default): local, the Lips_*_Bnd joints only move with the lip ctrls: moving the lips ctrl group, SetParent or anything above them (face install, global scale) never moves them.
  GameMode on: the bind joints copy the lip joints in world space (one skinCluster, game export).
  Lips: joints spaced evenly by length along each lip edge. Mid ctrls translate, scale and rotate: rotating one bends the lip around it, rx rolls the lip there. Tweak ctrls push the joints around them with a soft falloff. Every lip ctrl scales per axis and the scale falls off over the lip like its translate.
  Main ctrls: Roll on Lips_Up/Dw_Main_Ctrl. On L/R_Lips_Main_Ctrl: mode (BSP, default: this ctrl is free for the Commissures blendshapes, only L/R_Lips_Sub_Ctrl moves the lip corner. RIG: it moves the lip corner too, like v001), MovementMult / SubMovementMult (how much the Main / Sub ctrl moves the corner), MidFollow / MidFalloff (how much the corner drags each mid ctrl, high falloff = the front barely moves), CornerAim / AimFalloff (mid ctrls turn toward the corner as it moves) and AimMult (exaggerates that turn).
  Buccal flap (optional): L/R_Lips_Flap_Ctrl between one upper and one lower lip joint, squashes as the lips close (FlapBlend / Squash / Stretch on the flap ctrl).

How To Use:
  fill the key fields below. The Jaw block is separate, the build order does not matter.

Fields:
- SetParent: node the whole mouth follows (e.g. Skull_Lwr_Ctrl, Head_Ctrl). new_locator makes a placeholder.
- SetAttrsPosition: node that gets the Mouth_Vis attrs (e.g. Vis_Ctrl). new_locator makes a placeholder.
- GameMode: off = local bind joints for the BodyLips layer, on = world bind joints. The jaw never moves the lips in either mode.
- SetUpperEdge: upper lip edge loop, corner to corner.
- SetLowerEdge: lower lip edge loop, corner to corner.
- TweakCtrlsAmount: tweak ctrls per lip, corners not counted (default 7).
- MidCtrlsAmount: mid ctrls per lip (default 5).
- CtrlSize: ctrl size (default 4).
- BindJoints: PerVtx = one joint per vertex of the lip edge, or a fixed joint count per lip.
- LegacyBindNames: on = bind joints keep the Lips v001 / v002 names (Lips_Up_0_Bnd, Lips_Dw_0_Bnd... counted from the right corner), so rigs moved from v002 keep their skins and Skin blocks. Use it with BindJoints PerVtx to get the same joints as v002.
- MidCtrlTangents: on = mid ctrls spaced evenly on the lip, rotating them bends the lip. Off = mid ctrls translate only (older driver curve).
- BuccalFlap: adds L/R_Lips_Flap_Ctrl + Bnd joint at the mouth corner.
- SetFlapUpperJoint: upper lip joint the flap hangs from (select it and press Set). Left side, the right side is mirrored. Empty = the joint next to the corner.
- SetFlapLowerJoint: lower lip joint the flap hangs from, same rules as SetFlapUpperJoint.

Skin:
- Bind joints are named <side>_Lips_Up_Lip_NN_Bnd / Mid_Lips_Up_Lip_Bnd (Dw for the lower lip). Skin block SetJoints: *Lips_Up_Lip*_Bnd,*Lips_Dw_Lip*_Bnd,Null_Local_Bnd
- LegacyBindNames on: Lips_Up_0_Bnd... like v002, Skin block SetJoints: Lips_Up_*_Bnd,Lips_Dw_*_Bnd,Null_Local_Bnd

Tips:
- Name this block Mouth (and the Jaw block Mouth_Jaw) to get the MouthGames ctrl names, so animation transfers between the local and the game rigs (these lips never follow the jaw, the MouthGames ones do).
- start with defaults, build once, then tweak only the fields you need.
- Lips v001 / v002 blocks have no LipUp / LipDown guides: the main ctrls then sit on the Mid ctrls. Create a new block to get the guides.
